name: collisionrenderer-mcp
description: Local renderer for Collision Engineers branded PDFs (valuation report, advert evidence pack, fee note, expert reports) via the .NET CollisionRenderer engine.
long_description: Local Claude Desktop build of the CollisionRenderer engine. Exposes the document renderer over stdio: render_health preflight, list_templates/get_template_sample/validate/render for any of the 12 templates, plus render_valuation_outputs — a drop-in for the legacy report-renderer that renders the market-valuation report and advert evidence pack from one valuation payload (+ captured advert PDFs, attached by evidence_path file reference or inline base64). Rendering is HTML/Scriban → a Chromium headless shell that is BUNDLED inside the bundle (no runtime download or install), with automatic fallback to the system Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome if the bundled shell cannot launch. Self-contained: the .NET runtime, templates, brand assets, signatures and the headless Chromium shell are all shipped in the bundle. Windows-only.

browser_channel.title: PDF browser
browser_channel.description: Which browser renders PDFs. Leave unset (or 'bundled') for the headless shell shipped inside the bundle; set 'msedge' or 'chrome' to prefer the system browser first. Renders always fall back through bundled → Edge → Chrome automatically.

tools.name: render_health
tools.description: Preflight health check: launches the PDF browser and prints a probe PDF; reports how the browser resolved. Call before starting a valuation.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the document templates this renderer can produce.

tools.name: get_template_sample
tools.description: Return the bundled starter payload (JSON) for a template id.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate a payload against a template's schema/policy without rendering.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render any template to PDF; returns an artifact descriptor with a file:// uri.

tools.name: render_valuation_outputs
tools.description: Render the market-valuation report and advert evidence pack from one valuation payload (+ captures via evidence_path file references or inline base64). Drop-in for the legacy report-renderer.

tools.name: open_valuation_output
tools.description: Open the finished valuation PDFs in the OS default viewer, or reveal them in File Explorer (pass the artifacts[].uri from render_valuation_outputs).

tools.name: install_browser
tools.description: Manual fallback: download the headless Chromium shell if the bundled one is missing (idempotent). Normally unneeded — the shell ships inside the bundle.
